recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man with dark hair and a patterned shirt, set against a soft-focus garden background, framed by bold, rounded, yellow-and-orange typography in the upper corners.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered with head slightly tilted to create a friendly, approachable gaze.
Typography balanced in the top-left and top-right corners to frame the head.
Warm color palette in the foreground (red/orange shirt) contrasting with cool, muted greens in the background.
Heavy, rounded letterforms mirroring the soft, organic shapes of the foliage and hair.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium close-up, head and shoulders occupying the central 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes, specifically the direct gaze toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, moves to the subject's face, then to the top-right text, finally settling on the texture of the shirt.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blurred garden background provides breathing room around the subject's head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm earthy tones (terracotta red, skin tones, muted greens).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for primary text visibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Orange-red outlines on text to tie into the shirt color.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground subject and text; low saturation and value in the background.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to a 1970s analog film palette

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, rounded sans-serif with tight spacing.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are tilted slightly to create a bouncy, rhythmic feel
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform style across all text elements to maintain a cohesive 'brand' look.

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric but extremely rounded and thick.
Iconic rounded display face from the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s-style film photograph of a man with dark wavy hair wearing a red-orange patterned button-down shirt, standing in a soft-focus garden with green foliage. The lighting should be soft and natural.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, rounded uppercase text in the top-left and top-right corners. Use a bright yellow fill with a thick orange-red outline. Tilt the text blocks slightly for a dynamic feel.

verificationChecks: Is the text color yellow with a red outline?
Is the background sufficiently blurred to separate the subject?
Does the font have rounded terminals?
Is the overall color temperature warm?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and song title
Record label logo in the bottom corner
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the subject's eyes.
Check that the shirt pattern feels period-accurate (geometric/small repeat).
Verify the yellow of the text is vibrant enough to pop against the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Patterned Shirt + Soft Garden Background + Rounded Corner Typography = 70s Pop Aesthetic
